# TanStack Start conventions

## Runtime

- Use TanStack Start for full-stack React SSR and Node.js LTS for tooling.

## Build tool

- Use the Vite integration generated by TanStack Start.

## Package manager

- Use pnpm.

## Env contract

- Separate and validate server-only and browser-exposed values.

## Entry point

- Use `src/routes/` and the generated router module.

## Type checking

- Run `tsc --noEmit`.

## Generated code

- Never edit or report `src/routeTree.gen.ts` as unused.

## Commands

```sh
pnpm run dev
pnpm run build
pnpm run test
pnpm run lint
pnpm run format
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run knip
```

## Project Structure

- Preserve generator-owned files and apply the overlay after generation.
